p: וְלֹא נִזְכַּר בּוֹ כְּלָל שְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת,
Shemini Atzeres is not mentioned in it at all,
Yet Shemini Atzeres is a festival in its own right,
and the Men of the Great Assembly established
in the tefillah and in Kiddush
"the day of Shemini Atzeres, this festival."
it is expounded: "and you shall be only joyful"
to include the night of the last Yom Tov.
אֵיךְ נְרַבֶּה לֵילֵי יוֹם טוֹב הָאַחֲרוֹן
how can we include the night of the last Yom Tov,
which is not called the festival of Sukkos at all?
And in the Gemara, that we include
the night of the last Yom Tov
because there is rejoicing before it.
But since it has another name,
we would be compelled to include
the night of the first Yom Tov,
even though there is no rejoicing before it.
in the Gemara, the plain name "Chag"
refers to the festival of Sukkos
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ו, א, וּשְׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת),
(as they said in Rosh Hashanah 6a, and elsewhere),
that is, because then the holiness was established
And therefore one might have thought
that Shavuos too is called simply "Chag,"
since that was the time of the Giving of the Torah.
And it is written, "I said: you are godly beings"
and had it not been spoiled,
the rectification would have come then.
And it is written in the haftarah,
But what connection is there in calling
the festival of the dedication of the House a "chag"?
But the festival of Sukkos is named for
and these are the Clouds of Glory
And when they made the Mikdash,
and it is written, "and the cloud filled
Hashem said He would dwell in the thick cloud"
Yisrael sensed the holiness of the festival,
which is the holiness of the Clouds of Glory —
as it is written, "for eye to eye was seen,"
Nir'ah has the letters of Aharon —
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קג, א).
And this is the reason they made the festival
and did not fast on Yom Kippur.
who would say to ask the Sanhedrin?
Rather, they sensed the holiness of the festival.
And afterwards a heavenly voice went forth:
"All of you are destined for the life of the World to Come,"
And this is what it says,
which He spoke through Moshe His servant"
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
mentioned the good that is to come
But at that time they thought the rectification had already come,
And so it is written, "So that
all the peoples of the earth may know
and this will be in the future,
that it be engraved in the heart;
"and to keep His commandments as on this day" —
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם
as it says, "And God called the light day"
"this" — that it will be plain to the eye.
that Hashem did for David His servant"
that is to come to David His servant.
"and David My servant shall be their prince forever"
Now in truth there shines forth
the holiness of the festival and the Clouds of Glory
And so it is written, "And there gathered
in the month of Eisanim, at the festival;
which they call the first month, etc.,
and now it is the seventh month."
That is, before the Giving of the Torah
it was called the first month,
for he holds that in Tishrei
only "now," after the Giving of the Torah,
it is called the seventh month,
for Nissan is the head of the months.
But why is it mentioned at all,
"in the month of Eisanim, at the festival"?
the holiness of the festival shines forth,
which is "the time of our rejoicing,"
to rectify every flaw of Adam HaRishon
and for Tishrei to be the first month.
And so Shemini Atzeres is called "chag,"
one already senses the holiness of the festival.
From Rosh Hashanah is the beginning:
the fear, leading to teshuvah, to rectify;
up to the time of our rejoicing and Shemini Atzeres.
וְכֵן אָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ד, ב):
And so they said in the Gemara (Rosh Hashanah 4b):
the Eighth Day is a festival in its own right
with regard to the lottery, Shehecheyanu, its festival status,
its offering, its song and its blessing;
but with regard to make-up offerings,
all agree it is a make-up day for the first day —
שֶׁשְּׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת גַּם כֵּן נִקְרָא חַג,
for Shemini Atzeres too is called "chag,"
since the holiness of the festival shines forth
through the whole month, as was said.
